title: pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary
body:
## pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary

Adds a cell array QuadratureOffset (one offset per cell) whose metadata holds a quadrature-rule dictionary for each cell type, the starting point of ParaView's quadrature workflow. The quadrature tools work in sequence: pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary adds a cell offset array QuadratureOffset carrying the quadrature rules, pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints evaluates point fields at the quadrature points, and pvGenerateQuadraturePoints turns them into a point cloud. Rules exist only for triangles, quadratic triangles, pixels, quads, quadratic quads, tetrahedra and quadratic tetrahedra.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Hexahedra, wedges, pyramids and polyhedra are unsupported; the offset array is then left unfilled without a pipeline error.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary`. Identity: `filters/QuadratureSchemeDictionaryGenerator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
